items.title: Threat Actors Using Copyright Takedown Claims to Deploy Malware
items.description: A sophisticated malware campaign orchestrated by the Vietnamese Lone None threat actor group has been leveraging fraudulent copyright infringement takedown notices to deploy information-stealing malware onto unsuspecting victims’ systems.
